paite: Hiaite pimang a om koltanna a kipan a paitou, bial a tate, Babulon lam a akumpipa Nebukad-nezzar in apimang, Jerusalem leh Judah a, michih ama khua chiat a hong kik nawnte ahi uh.
heading: Saltang Kik Nawnte Min Gelhkhiakna / (Neh 7.4-73)

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah toh hong tonte, Israel mite lak a pasal phazah:
Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat leh sawm-le-nih.
Kiriath-arim, Kephirah leh Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
Ramah leh Geba tate, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
Bethel leh Ai mite, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
Elam dang suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
Lod, Hadid leh Ono tate, zasagih sawmnih-le-nga.
Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkote, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
Levi mite: Jeshua leh Kadmiel suante, Hodaviah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
Kongkhak ngak mite: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, avek un zakhat sawmthum-le-kua.
Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha leh Tabbaoth suante;
Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Hassopheret leh Peruda suante;
Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ami suante.
Nethinim mite teng, Solomon sikhate tate, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
Huchi in hiaite Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan leh Immer a kipan a paitoute ahi uh: himahleh apipute inkote, asuan uh, Israel a kipan ahi uhia chih ataklang thei kei uh:
Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
Huan siampute suante: Habaiah, Hakkoz leh Barzillai Gilead mi Barzillai tanute a kipan azi kitenpihpa suante, amau min zui a sak in a-om hi.
Hiai khangthu sutna a sim mite lak a min gelhna azong ua, himahleh amu kei uh. Huaiziak in buah a sim in a-om ua siamputna a kipan dangkoih in a-om uhi.
Huan Tirshatha in, siampu Urim leh Thummim toh ahong dinkhiak mateng, thil siangthoupente ne lou ding in amau ahilh hi.
Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le- sawmguk ahi.
Apasal sikhate uleh anumei sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in pasal lasami leh numei lasami sangnih anei uhi.
Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum- le-guk ahi ua; sakol neute, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
Sangawngsaute, zali sawmthum- le-nga; sabiltung uh, sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
Huan Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn ahong tun un, apipute uh inkuan lak a alupente akhen in, TOUPA' inn alamna ding in ut thu a thillat alan uhi.
Nasepna sumbawm ah ahihtheihdan un dangka-eng darik singguk-le-sangkhat, dangka paun sangnga leh siampute puansilh zakhat.
Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, mite lak a akhenkhat leh lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, akhopite uah ateng ua, Israel mite akhopite uah ateng uhi.
